description: This file defines the WebChatManager class and related UI components for managing web chat sessions and panels within a macOS application, including showing, toggling, closing, and session handling.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can accept key focus.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum representing the presentation style of the web chat (window or panel).

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing web chat sessions, including showing, toggling panels, and session management.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a web chat window for the specified session key.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the web chat panel anchored to a specific provider.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the web chat panel if it is open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the preferred session key, caching the result.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Resets all session-related states and controllers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all sessions and resets states.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles the event when the panel is hidden, triggers visibility change callback.
